d: Margadarshi chit phand' ki mainejing dayrektar (MD) cherukuri shailja kiran ne shanivar ko telangana ke medchal men kanpni ki naee branch ka udghatan kiya. branch ke uddhatan ke bad emdi shailja kiran ne kaha, "yah organaijeshan hamesha midil klas ke sapnon ke lie ek sahara bankar khara hai."is mauke par unhonne nae sabsakraibars (sadasy) ko chit slips din. medchal men is branch ke jurne ke sath hi, margadarshi branch ki kul sankhya 136 ho gaee hai.shailja kiran ne kaha ki har tarah ke log margadarshak ke sadasy hain. unhonne bataya ki isse log aasan aur mainejebal kishton ke jarie…
